newsitem.title: USA: Motorola gets $97 million Brazil contract.
newsitem.headline: Motorola gets $97 million Brazil contract.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Pan American Wireless Infrastructure Division said on Monday it signed a $97 million contract to provide a cellular telephone network in Brazil.

Telecomunicacoes de Sao Paulo SA (TELESP) will deploy Motorola's Advanced Mobile Phone Service network for more than 100,000 subscribers in Sao Paulo. Commercial service is scheduled to begin in the second quarter of 1997.

"Brazil is an extremely important cellular market, as indicated by its growth and continued demand for advanced communications," said Jack Finlayson, corporate vice president of the Motorola division.
